title: Do Androids Dream of Electric Sheep?
author: Philip K. Dick
summary: On a poisoned, half-empty Earth, a bounty hunter is assigned to track down and retire six escaped androids that look and talk like people. The job makes him question what empathy actually is.
readIf: you like short, strange science fiction about what makes a person real.
skipIf: you want the sleek action of the film it inspired, since the book is quieter, odder and more philosophical.

pairings.reason: Another look at the inner life of a made being, told with far more tenderness.
A similarly grimy, neon-lit future with a cynical lead, but with more speed and style.
A calmer, puzzle-driven set of stories about the line between machine and person.
